notes.content:

notes.title: v110 2025.01.20 Shortcuts and Posing
notes.content:
v110        2025.01.20        Shortcuts and Posing
- ADDED - Shortcuts for translate (W), scale(R), rotate(E), local/world coordinate (F), pivot/center(D)
- ADDED - Bones get hidden if you click anything else than a poseable actor
- ADDED - Bones  become visible if you click on a poseable actor
- ADDED - Color codes to the bone for ease of use
- ADDED - The option to select and manipulate multiple bones at the same time by pressing SHIFT
- CHANGED - Better click handling and object priority detection
- FIXES - Posing actions are better recorded in the Undo stack

notes.title: v109 - 2024.12.16 - Various Quality of Life Fixes
notes.content:
- ADDED - Models can be deleted with "Delete" key
- ADDED - Attach and detach options to the scene menu.
- CHANGED - When selecting a new feet or hand the bone controls automatically change to the new selection
- CHANGED - The pivot point of the ruler to be on the end for easier handling
- CHANGED - Improved optimization, start up time should be a lot quicker on slower machines and less memory is used
- FIXED - A bug when sometimes a bone was selected, but could not be moved with the gizmo.
- FIXED - A bug when bones could not be selected while it was intersecting another model
- FIXED - VR hands stayed visible in Desktop mode
- FIXED - Environment rotation was not saved properly and reseted after any button press
- FIXED - When selecting some feet preset scenes the feet was not poseable after clicking "start posing"
